a732786f8c.q: What is the success trap that Angus Nelson describes for entrepreneurs?
a732786f8c.a: The success trap occurs when what got you to your current level will keep you there if you do not adjust. As businesses grow, leaders face an inflection point requiring them to become a new version of themselves. If they do not grow personally and emotionally with the business, decision quality declines, communication becomes harder, patience shortens, and the growth becomes heavier instead of rewarding.

a0a55a76ec.q: How does Angus Nelson distinguish between dark energy and light energy in entrepreneurship?
a0a55a76ec.a: Dark energy is when entrepreneurs seek fulfillment and validation from external sources, always looking for the next thing that will make them feel worthy, which is exhausting and never-ending. Light energy is when entrepreneurs understand their meaning, contribution, source, and abundance already exist inside them, so their work becomes an expression and expansion from within rather than a desperate search outside themselves.
